headline: Ithaca Security Deposit Rules: Cap, Deadline, Banned Fees
dek: For renters in Ithaca and their parents: what a landlord can charge, what's banned, and how to get your deposit back on time.

takeaways.point: A deposit can't exceed one month's rent, including any rent paid in advance.
Application and cleaning fees are banned; a background check is capped at $20.
The landlord has 14 days after move-out to return it with an itemized list, or loses the right to keep any of it.

spine_reason: Readers meet these rules in order: at signing, during the lease, at move-out, and if the deposit doesn't come back.
